propositions: _assemble_context_uncached swallows child-enumeration and per-child-fetch failures via bare except Exception, silently continuing with empty/partial children list, causing PlanContext.has_children to become False and container-scoped DET checks to return trivial pass instead of reporting incompleteness

When hierarchy enumeration fails completely, PlanContext.children becomes an empty list, flipping has_children to False, which causes p5_task_dag and p8_reviewability checks to skip execution and return pass, violating AC #4 that plan review cannot produce clean pass with incomplete hierarchy

finalize_verdict is called from five sites (precheck, coach, two recovery paths, degrade path) but only two currently thread hierarchy completeness information via coverage dict, leaving three call sites unable to signal INDETERMINATE when needed

plan_review_coach receives a minimal reconstructed PlanContext with no hierarchy data and must source hierarchy_incomplete/hierarchy_incomplete_detail flags from ctx.inputs (precheck step outputs) via YAML with: block threading, which is currently missing
Retry mechanism does not exist for list_tickets or show_ticket failures; a bounded 2-attempt retry with 50ms fixed delay must be added before setting hierarchy_incomplete flag
